entries.source: I am back from the Charred Scar, where the orcs took the staff.
entries.target: 我从灼烧之痕回来了，兽人把法杖带到了那里。

entries.source:
The news has indeed reached me. I could scarce believe it, so long have we been at war with the Pride.
Now they are dead? At the hands of just one @playerdescriptor.race@? Truly I am amazed by your power.
While you were busy bringing an end to the orcs, we managed to discover some parts of the truth from a captive orc.
He talked about the shield protecting the High Peak. It seems to be controlled by "orbs of command" which the masters of the Prides had in their possession.
He also said the only way to enter the peak and de-activate the shield is through the "slime tunnels", located somewhere in one of the Prides, probably Grushnak.
entries.target:
我的确已经得到了消息，真令人难以置信，我们和兽人已经战斗得太久了。
他们现在都死了么？仅凭一个 @playerdescriptor.race@ 的力量？你的力量真让我惊叹。
当你忙于解决那些兽人的时候，我们设法从那个兽人俘虏那里获得了一些线索。
他提起了有关巅峰保护罩的事。似乎那个护罩是受“指令水晶球”操控的，那些指令水晶球就在兽人各大部落首领的手中。
他还说想要进入巅峰并关闭护罩的唯一通道是“史莱姆通道”，位于某一个兽人部落内，有可能是格鲁希纳克的部落。

entries.source:
I have already sent parties to clear out the remainder of the prides as you progressed, and have instructed to keep a sharp eye out for any orbs of command you may have missed.
	Which do you not have? I can check with the parties if they found any. Our sources indicate that you should have four: one of Undeath, one of Destruction, one of Dragons, and one of Elemental might.
entries.target:
我们已经派出部队，清理那些被你所击溃的部落的残军。我命令他们仔细搜查，留意任何你可能遗漏的指令水晶球。
	你缺少了什么水晶球？我会去问问他们，看看他们有没有找到。根据我们得到的情报，你应该有四颗指令水晶球：亡灵水晶球，毁灭水晶球，巨龙水晶球，元素水晶球。

entries.target: 利米尔需要更多金币用于魔法镀层。

entries.target: 你需要花费 %s 金币用于镀金，你确认接受吗？

entries.source: Limmir's Amulet of the Moon
entries.target: 利米尔的月亮吊坠

entries.source: Welcome, @playername@, to my shop.
entries.target: 欢迎来我的商店，@playername@。

entries.source: Let me see your wares.
entries.target: 让我看看你的商品吧。

entries.source: I am looking for special jewelry.
entries.target: 我在找一些特殊的珠宝。

entries.source: So you can infuse amulets in this place?
entries.target: 据说你可以给项链附魔？

entries.source: I have found this tome; it looked important.
entries.target: 我找到了这本手册，看上去好像很重要。

entries.source: Sorry I have to go!
entries.target: 抱歉，我必须得走了！

entries.source:
Then you are at the right place, for I am an expert jeweler.
If you bring me a gem and a ring, I can create a new ring imbued with the properties of the gem.  The original traits of the ring will be lost in the process but new ones of similar quality will be generated.
There is a small fee dependent on the level of the ring, and you need a quality ring to use a quality gem.
entries.target:
你算找对地方了，我可是一个珠宝专家。
如果你给我找来一颗宝石和一枚戒指，我可以帮你把宝石的力量镶嵌到戒指里去。这枚戒指原有的所有属性都会消失，不过也会生成一些质量相似的新属性。
不过根据戒指等级我要收取一小笔费用。你得用高品质的戒指来搭配高品质的宝石。

entries.source: I need your services.
entries.target: 我需要你的服务。

entries.source: Not now, thanks.
entries.target: 暂时不用，谢了。

entries.source:
Yes! Thanks to you this place is now free from the corruption. I will stay on this island to study the magical aura, and as promised I can make you powerful amulets.
Bring me a an amulet and two different gems and I will turn them into a powerful amulet, though the original properties of the amulet will be lost.
I will not make you pay a fee for it since you helped me so much, but I am afraid the ritual requires a gold plating. This should be equal to about 1000 gold pieces.
entries.target:
对！多亏了你，这个地方已经摆脱了腐化。我会留在这个岛上研究魔法光环，我会遵守我的诺言帮你制作一条强力的项链。
给我带来一条项链还有两颗不同的宝石，我会利用它们制作一条强力的项链。
你帮了我那么多，这次我不收任何费用。不过制作过程中需要镀金工艺，这大约得花费 1000 金币，而且项链原本的属性将不复存在。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He quickly looks at the tome and looks amazed.*#WHITE# This is an amazing find! Truly amazing!
With this knowledge I could create potent amulets. However, it requires a special place of power to craft such items.
There are rumours about a site of power in the southern mountains. Old legends tell about a place where a part of the Wintertide Moon melted when it got too close to the Sun and fell from the sky.
A lake formed in the crater of the crash. The water of this lake, soaked in intense Moonlight for eons, should be sufficient to forge powerful artifacts!
Go to the lake and then summon me with this scroll. I will retire to study the tome, awaiting your summon.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他快速浏览了那本手册，露出了惊讶的表情。*#WHITE# 这真是神奇的发现！太神奇了！
有了这些知识，我就能制造强力的项链了。不过，制作这样的物品需要一个特殊的力量之地。
传言南部山脉中有一处力量之地。古老传说称，霜华之月的一部分因离太阳过近而融化，并从天空坠落。
坠落形成的陨坑中出现了一座湖泊。这座湖的湖水经过强烈月光的浸润，历经了漫长岁月，应该足以锻造强大的神器！
前往那座湖，然后用这张卷轴召唤我。我会回去研究这本手册，等待你的召唤。

entries.source: I will see if I can find it.
entries.target: 我看看能不能找到那个地方。

entries.source: #VIOLET#*Before you stands Berethh. His face shows no emotion, but his posture is threatening.#LAST#
entries.target: #VIOLET#*贝里斯站在你的面前。他面无表情，但姿态充满威胁。#LAST#

entries.source: Kyless is dead.
entries.target: 凯勒斯死了。

entries.source: I'm not sure if you deserved your fate. Still I cannot let you live.
entries.target: 我不确定你落得这般下场是否罪有应得。但我依然不能留你活命。

entries.source: Then you will die like Kyless. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]#LAST#
entries.target: 那么你也会像凯勒斯一样死去。#LIGHT_GREEN#[攻击]#LAST#

entries.source: I need your help. I want to overcome my curse.
entries.target: 我需要你的帮助。我想要摆脱我的诅咒。

entries.source: I do not want to kill you.
entries.target: 我不想杀你。

entries.source: #VIOLET#*Berethh ignores your comment, unslings his bow and prepares his attack.*#LAST#
entries.target: #VIOLET#*贝里斯无视了你的话，取下背上的弓，准备发起攻击。*#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#[Attack]
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#[攻击]

entries.source:
#VIOLET#*As the last member of the caravan lies dying, you look at him and see the hate that fills his eyes.*#LAST#
We should have finished you off that day. You deserved no mercy!
entries.target:
#VIOLET#*当商队的最后一名成员奄奄一息时，你看着他，看到他眼中充满了仇恨。*#LAST#
我们那天真该彻底除掉你。你根本不配得到怜悯！

entries.source: And I will show you no mercy. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Kill him]#LAST#
entries.target: 而我也绝不会对你手下留情。#LIGHT_GREEN#[杀了他]#LAST#

entries.source: I am sorry. #LIGHT_GREEN#[Help him]#LAST#
entries.target: 对不起。#LIGHT_GREEN#[帮助他]#LAST#

entries.source: #VIOLET#*Before you can help him, he collapses to the ground and dies.*#LAST#
entries.target: #VIOLET#*你还没来得及帮助他，他就倒在地上死去了。*#LAST#

entries.source:
#VIOLET#*Kyless lies dying on the floor. In his hand he holds a book.*#LAST#
Please! Before I die I have one request. Destroy the book. It wasn't me. The book brought this on us. It must be destoyed!
entries.target:
#VIOLET#*凯勒斯躺在地板上奄奄一息。他的手里还握着一本书。*#LAST#
求求你！临死前，我有一个请求。毁掉这本书。其实不是我，是这本书将灾难带给了我们。它必须被毁掉！

entries.source: I will. #LIGHT_GREEN#[destroy the book]#LAST#
entries.target: 我会的。#LIGHT_GREEN#[毁掉这本书]#LAST#

entries.source: I'm sorry but I need it. #LIGHT_GREEN#[keep the book]#LAST#
entries.target: 对不起，但我需要它。#LIGHT_GREEN#[留下这本书]#LAST#

entries.source: #VIOLET#*You destroy the book. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
entries.target: #VIOLET#*你毁掉了这本书。当你做完这一切后，你发现凯勒斯已经死了。*#LAST#

entries.source: Goodbye, Kyless.
entries.target: 再见，凯勒斯。

entries.source: #VIOLET#*You place the book in your pack. When you finish you look up and see that Kyless is already dead.*#LAST#
entries.target: #VIOLET#*你将这本书放到了背包里。当你做完这一切后，你发现凯勒斯已经死了。*#LAST#

entries.source: Welcome, @playername@, to Last Hope. Traveler, please be quick as my time is precious.
entries.target: 欢迎你，@playername@，来到最后的希望。旅行者，请长话短说，我的时间很宝贵。

entries.source: I have found a strange staff in my travels (#LIGHT_GREEN#*describe it in detail*#LAST#)  It looked very old and very powerful. I dared not use it.
entries.target: 我在旅途中找到了一根奇怪的法杖（#LIGHT_GREEN#*详细描述它的外观*#LAST#）。它看起来非常古老且威力强大，我不敢使用它。

entries.source: The hunt for the staff took me to a continent far to the east, accessible only by magic portal. I've recently returned by just such a portal, and I come bearing instructions on how to construct a similar portal here in Last Hope to make the return journey possible. I'm sure the Elves there would welcome trade with the west.
entries.target: 追查法杖的线索让我去往了遥远的东方大陆，那里只能通过魔法传送门前往。我最近刚通过这样一个传送门返回，并带来了如何在最后的希望建造类似传送门以重返东方的指引。我相信那里的精灵会很乐意与西方开展贸易。

entries.source: Nothing, excuse me. Bye!
entries.target: 没事，抱歉打扰了，再见！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*He remains silent for a while*#WHITE# Indeed you were right to come here.
The staff you describe reminds me of an artifact of great power from ancient times. May I see it?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他沉默了片刻*#WHITE# 你来这里确实是对的。
你所描述的法杖让我想起了一件来自远古的强大神器。能让我看一眼吗？

entries.source: Here it is. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*#LAST# You should keep it. I can feel its power and it would be safer if it were guarded by the armies of the kingdom.
entries.target: 就在这里。#LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他遭遇兽人的事*#LAST# 应该由你来保管它。我能感受到它的力量，如果由王国军队看守会安全得多。

entries.source: I am afraid I lost it. #LIGHT_GREEN#*Tell him about the encounter with the orcs*
entries.target: 恐怕我把它弄丢了。#LIGHT_GREEN#*告诉他遭遇兽人的事*

entries.source: I had it briefly but have lost it somehow.  It could have been some orcs I encountered ...
entries.target: 我曾短暂持有过它，但不知怎么弄丢了。可能与我遇到的那些兽人有关……

entries.source:
I am truly astonished by your strength; surviving that encounter was an epic feat.
As for the orcs, it is deeply troubling.  We have not seen any for eighty years... could they have come from the far east?
Anyway, thank you again, @playername@, for your help.
entries.target:
你的实力令我由衷惊叹；能在遭遇战中生还真是一项史诗般的壮举。
至于兽人，这令人深感忧虑。我们已经有八十年没见过他们了……难道他们来自远东？
无论如何，再次感谢你的帮助，@playername@。

entries.source: Thank you, my lord.
entries.target: 谢谢你，阁下。

entries.source:
Orcs?! In the west?! This is deeply alarming! We have not seen any for nearly eighty years. They must have come from the far east...
But do not let me trouble you; you brought important news and you are lucky to be alive.
entries.target:
兽人？！在西方？！这令人深感忧虑！我们已经将近八十年没见过任何兽人了。他们必定来自远东……
不过我不该用这些烦扰你；你带来了重要消息，能够死里逃生已是万幸。

entries.source:
We have heard rumours from the Dwarves that there may still be an orc presence deep in the old kingdom of Reknor, in the Iron Throne.
I know you have been through a lot, but we need somebody to investigate and determine if there is a connection with the staff.
entries.target:
我们从矮人那里听到传闻，在钢铁王座境内的瑞库纳古王国深处可能仍有兽人出没。
我知道你历经艰险，但我们需要有人前去调查，查明这是否与那根法杖有关。

entries.source: I will check the mines.
entries.target: 我会去矿坑那里调查。

entries.source: That's extraordinary! I know a number of merchant princes who will salivate at the idea of new trade routes opening. But tell me, how fares your quest for the staff?
entries.target: 真不可思议！我知道不少巨商一想到开辟新商路就会垂涎三尺。不过快告诉我，你追查法杖的进展如何了？

entries.source: The staff is recovered and the culprits slain. They will trouble us no more. [tell him the whole story]
entries.target: 法杖已经找回，元凶已被诛杀。他们不会再危害我们了。[告诉他事情的完整经过]

entries.source: The hunt continues. The construction of this portal will be of great assistance in the staff's recovery.
entries.target: 追查仍在继续。建造这座传送门将极大地帮助我们找回法杖。

entries.source: Excellent! Well then, concerning this fascinating portal, I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
entries.target: 太棒了！那么，关于这座引人入胜的传送门，恐怕人类大多早已遗忘了曾经掌握的远古的强大魔法。在这片土地上，我只知道有一人或许能帮上你——一位最近刚来到最后的希望的智者，名叫泰恩。他自称来自安格利文，那是传闻中魔法与神秘主义修行者的避难所。他几个月前带着巨额财富来到这里，已经在城北建造了自己的法师塔。我对他了解不多，但如果他的话可信，那他就是你最大的希望。

entries.source: Thank you.
entries.target: 谢谢。

entries.source: In that case, let us proceed as quickly as possible. Now, concerning this fascinating portal. I'm afraid that men have largely forgotten whatever they once knew about the great magics of old. I know of only one man in these lands who might be able to help you, a wise man and recent arrival to Last Hope named Tannen. He claims to hail from Angolwen, a supposed haven for practitioners of magic and mysticism. He arrived just months ago with fabulous wealth and has already constructed his own tower in the northern part of the city. I know little of him, but if he is to be believed, then he is your best hope.
entries.target: 既然如此，那我们就尽快行动吧。那么，关于这座引人入胜的传送门，恐怕人类大多早已遗忘了曾经掌握的远古的强大魔法。在这片土地上，我只知道有一人或许能帮上你——一位最近刚来到最后的希望的智者，名叫泰恩。他自称来自安格利文，那是传闻中魔法与神秘主义修行者的避难所。他几个月前带着巨额财富来到这里，已经在城北建造了自己的法师塔。我对他了解不多，但如果他的话可信，那他就是你最大的希望。
